title: VAR Is Watching
truth: THE RIGHT CALL: GOAL. When the ball was passed, the striker was onside by 30 cm.
goal: Your goal: give the referee the right call, GOAL or OFFSIDE. Gianno Infantini on the TV always tells you what to do next.

hints.pundit: Sticky note on your desk, rookie. Read it! Then find the mascot. His door needs the ref's whistle. And stay out of the server room. Nothing in there.
Got a whistle? Blow it at the Mascot Room door and interview a bear. Live on my show. I'm crying.
A USB stick from a bear. Plug it into your VAR computer, genius. Also... anyone seen my press pass? No reason.
hints.pundit_if_clue: A USB stick from a bear. Plug it into your VAR computer, genius. And that press pass? Never seen it. Never.

hints.pundit: Pitch time! Tell the ref GOAL or OFFSIDE. It's offside, obviously. 0:0 is a beautiful result. Trust me. I'm the expert.
Uh-oh, the press! Choose your words, rookie. Or don't. I'd prefer you don't.

ball_goal_pundit: INFANTINI: Did the VAR official just score?! Somebody check the VAR! Oh wait... that's you. Doesn't count, rookie.

booth.name: VAR Booth
booth.text: 94th minute, cup final, 0:0. Home side scores, away captain screams "OFFSIDE!" at the sky. Day one as VAR, and the offside camera is dead. Its red cable runs straight into the server room. Find the angle, make the call.

actions.label: Go to the Server Room
actions.text: You follow the red cable through the door. It smells of hot plastic.

actions.label: Go to the Referee's Dressing Room
actions.text: You sprint down the tunnel, past a trolley of orange slices.

actions.label: Go to the Mascot Changing Room
actions.blocked_text: Locked. Sign: "MASCOTS ONLY. Whistle for entry." The ref keeps a spare whistle in his room.
actions.text: You blow the Lucky Whistle. A bear growls. The door clicks open.

actions.label: Go to the Pitch
actions.text: Floodlights. Sixty thousand heads turn. Your knees remember they are knees.

actions.label: Look at the sticky note
actions.text: Dave's note says: "Back in 5 min - Dave. P.S. Angle cuts out? Ask Bernie, our mascot. He films EVERYTHING."

actions.label: Look behind the desk
actions.text: Behind the desk: a PRESS PASS. Photo: Gianno Infantini, grinning. What is a TV expert doing in the VAR booth?

actions.label: Plug the USB Stick into the VAR computer
actions.blocked_text: Nice USB port. Shame you have nothing to plug in.
actions.text: You plug in the USB Stick. Bernie's head-cam footage fills the screen.

dressing_room.name: Referee's Dressing Room
dressing_room.text: Steam, muddy boots, half an orange. A poster: "TRUST THE PROCESS". Smells of deep heat and fear.

actions.label: Open the drawer of the kit cabinet
actions.text: The drawer squeaks open. Inside: shoelaces, an energy bar and a whistle.

actions.label: Take the Lucky Whistle from the drawer
actions.text: Someone wrote LUCKY on it in marker pen, so it must be true.

actions.label: Look in the bin
actions.text: A crumpled betting slip: "500 pounds - DRAW 0:0 - late offside drama". Signed: G. Infantini. He was here before kick-off, "just chatting with the ref"?!

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: Back to the booth. The static is still there.

mascot_room.name: Mascot Changing Room
mascot_room.text: Fur everywhere. Bernie the bear mascot sulks on a bench. He stood right by the corner flag when the goal went in.

actions.label: Ask Bernie what he saw
actions.text: Bernie pulls off his head. It's Dave, the missing VAR operator! "Second job. Don't tell HR." He hands you his head-cam USB: "At 93:30 a shiny suit ran out of your booth."

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You leave Dave to put his head back on.

server_room.name: Server Room
server_room.text: Humming servers, blinking lights, an icy breeze from the floor vents. The red cable from your booth ends here, on the floor. Cut clean through. Still sparking.

actions.label: Look at the cut cable
actions.text: Stuck in the cut: the tip of a blue silk tie, cut clean. Gold initials: G.I.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You leave the server room. The servers hum goodbye.

pitch.name: The Pitch
pitch.text: Sixty thousand fans on their feet. Flag up, captain screaming. The ref stares at you: "VAR, what's your call?"

actions.label: Rule: GOAL
actions.text: You signal GOAL! The ref blows the final whistle. Then the ground shakes: a stampede of journalists is running straight at you!

actions.label: Rule: OFFSIDE
actions.text: You signal OFFSIDE! The ref blows the final whistle. Then the ground shakes: a stampede of journalists is running straight at you!

actions.label: Say: 'Guys, it was clearly ONSIDE. A regular goal!'
actions.text: Forty microphones in your face. You say it loud and clear. One journalist faints. Nobody knows why.

actions.label: Say: 'Guys, it was clearly OFFSIDE. No goal!'
actions.text: Forty microphones in your face. You say it loud and clear. Somewhere, a freeze-frame is being made.

actions.label: Say: 'No comment.'
actions.text: "No comment." Calm. Professional. Boring. Forty journalists sigh at once.

actions.label: Say: 'Gianno Infantini cut the camera cable. Here is the proof.'
actions.text: You hold up his press pass, his betting slip and the tip of his tie. In the stands, a bear waves. Every camera turns to the TV studio.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You walk back inside. Sixty thousand people boo at once. Impressive.

review.intro: Bernie's head-cam footage runs for 3 seconds. Find the exact moment the ball leaves the passer's boot and lock it. Then draw the offside line: it goes on the second-last opponent (the goalkeeper counts as one), and level counts as onside. You only get one look.
rules: An attacker is OFFSIDE if he is closer to the goal than the second-last
defender at the exact moment the ball is passed to him.
The goalkeeper counts as a defender. Level with the defender = ONSIDE.
STEP 1: Find the moment the ball leaves the passer's boot (red 8). Lock it.
STEP 2: Put the offside line on the second-last defender. Lock it.
Then you see if the striker (red 9) is past your line.
review.onside_text: The striker is level with or behind your line: ONSIDE.
review.offside_text: The striker is past your line: OFFSIDE.

daylight_robbery.title: Daylight Robbery
daylight_robbery.text: OFFSIDE! The goal is gone, it ends 0:0. By morning, freeze-frames all over the internet show the striker was onside by 30 cm. The home fans wrote a song about you. It is not a nice song.
daylight_robbery.tip: TIP: In the VAR Review, freeze the exact moment the ball leaves the boot, then line up the second-last defender.

lucky_guess.title: Lucky Guess
lucky_guess.text: GOAL! It ends 1:0. You never watched the footage. You just guessed. You guessed right! The papers ask: "Did the VAR even look?" You did not.
lucky_guess.tip: TIP: Check the footage first. Bernie the mascot has it.

by_the_book.title: By the Book
by_the_book.text: GOAL! It ends 1:0. You checked the footage, drew the line and got it right. Textbook. The referee nods at you. From a referee, that is basically a hug.
by_the_book.tip: TIP: Find every clue and tell the press who cut the cable.

var_is_watching.title: VAR Is Watching
var_is_watching.text: GOAL! It ends 1:0. You got the call right AND caught the man who cut the cable. Day one. Not bad, rookie.
var_is_watching.tip: PERFECT GAME: the right call, and Infantini is caught. You are a natural.

time_up.title: The Stadium Went Home
time_up.text: You took too long. The referee flips a coin: OFFSIDE. It ends 0:0. Half the stadium has already gone home. The other half is booing you personally.
time_up.tip: TIP: Infantini on the TV always tells you the next step. Follow the "!" markers.

epilogues.arrested: Meanwhile, in the TV studio: two police officers walk in. Click. Handcuffs. Gianno Infantini leaves with his head down and half a tie. [SIGNAL LOST]
epilogues.wins: Meanwhile, in the TV studio, Gianno Infantini kisses his betting slip: 0:0, 500 pounds won. Nobody will ever know who cut the cable. Or will they? (Play again to find out.)
epilogues.loses: Meanwhile, in the TV studio, Gianno Infantini crumples his betting slip. 500 pounds, gone. Nobody will ever know who cut the cable. Or will they? (Play again to find out.)
